paper_title: Axion dark matter from topological defects
coupling_convention: x = f_a (F_a) in GeV, y = m_a in eV (QCD axion relation from DM abundance matching)
notes: This is a theoretical/cosmological calculation of the axion cold dark matter abundance produced by strings and domain walls in the post-inflationary PQ-breaking scenario, not an experimental exclusion of a coupling constant. The main result is that axions saturate the DM abundance for m_a=(0.8-1.3)x10^-4 eV (N_DW=1) and m_a~O(10^-4-10^-2) eV (N_DW>1, with mild tuning), equivalently F_a<=O(10^9-10^10) GeV. There is no coupling-vs-mass exclusion curve; the emitted f_a-m_a points are derived from the stated mass window via the QCD axion mass-f_a relation (m_a(0)=sqrt(c0)*Lambda_QCD^2/F_a, c0=1.46e-3, Lambda=400 MeV) and are approximate.
